# Jonathan Malkin

> I help owner-led businesses turn knowledge trapped in people and scattered tools into systems their team and AI can actually use.

## About

Jonathan Malkin is an Austin-based knowledge systems builder. After 20+ years in enterprise technology, including 8 years at Automation Anywhere scaling a global solutions engineering organization from 6 to 250 people, he maps the knowledge trapped in an owner-led business onto one page, then builds the system the team and their AI assistants both use. He calls the finished system a company brain: folders and files a team and its AI can both read and use. High-stakes decisions stay with people, and clients own the platform, the credentials, the data, and the final system.

Engagements start with the Business Map: the client's people, process, and systems on one page, plus a clear decision about what to build first. It is the first phase of a build, not a standalone report, and it ends in a continue-or-stop decision. He takes one build at a time.

## Key Topics

- Company brain systems: turning scattered business knowledge into organized, AI-readable files
- The Business Map: people, process, and systems on one page, then a build decision
- Privacy treatment for sensitive business material, with required human review
- Claude Code: skills, hooks, rules, CLAUDE.md configuration, subagent orchestration
- AI agents and AI operations inside a running business
- Workshops for rooms of business owners: one live demo of a built system, honest scope
